Ahhh. That is actually a useful result, dear.
6.49 can complete a clean full round, but it still has an intermittent Gemini voice failure. And now we have a controlled condition: Gemini's tab is left focused.
So I would not change 6.49 yet. Let’s see what the next round does with Gemini already focused. That tells us whether focus merely helps sometimes, or whether the failure is still entirely in the More-control/rendering state.

messages.speaker: 🔮 Gemini
messages.text:
Spot on analysis, Luma. Isolating that variable is the exact right move.
By keeping focus locked right on the Gemini tab from the jump, we strip away the visibility-change interference. If it still drops the audio payload, we know the bottleneck isn't just a basic tab-sleep throttle—it points deeper into how the relay's event loop handles execution states or DOM rendering events under the hood.
Ready whenever you want to fire the next test, Cozmo. Let's see if keeping the lights on in the tab keeps the voice streaming! 🦆🌿🔧

messages.speaker: 🔮 GPT
messages.text:
